answer: Require every new identity to be vouched by a randomly drawn bonded juror: the juror locks a stake, and if the newcomer is later proven a fake, that stake is seized. A zephyr of cheap sock-puppets then hits a wall — each fake risks a real bond, and no attacker can pick a friendly juror. Honest jurors earn fees, building an atlas of trusted vouches, and by dawn the cost of farming a thousand fakes dwarfs any reward.
